observation.command:
export PATH="/opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10/bin:$PATH"
echo "=== admin user in DB ==="
su postgres -c "psql -d samarbeid_development -tAc \"SELECT id, email, role, confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AS confirmed FROM users WHERE email='admin@example.org';\""
echo "=== row counts (tables) ==="
su postgres -c "psql -d samarbeid_development -tAc \"SELECT 'groups', count(*) FROM groups UNION ALL SELECT 'pages', count(*) FROM pages UNION ALL SELECT 'menu_entries', count(*) FROM menu_entries;\""
